description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No.76 Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. Order under Section 20(5) Maximum Price for Sugar
reasoning: This gazette content is a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail and wholesale prices for sugar products, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for commercial activities. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
